item.title: New York DMV Commissioner announces retirement
item.description: With over seven years under his belt as Department of Motor Vehicles Commissioner, Mark J.F. Schroeder has announced his retirement.

item.title: Milder, then colder with light weekend snow!
item.description: We’re heading into a quieter and milder stretch to start the weekend! After today’s drying trend, high pressure settles in and keeps things mostly clear and calm through Saturday. item.title: Hochul drubs Blakeman in Marist Poll as 33% of New Yorkers want to leave
item.description: According to the Marist Poll, Governor Kathy Hochul has reached her highest job approval rating in over four years, while most New Yorkers feel they can't afford the high cost of living and 33% of New Yorkers plan to move out of the state in five years.

item.title: The 12 Joint Legislative Hearings Come to an End
item.description: Over the past month, New York’s Assembly and Senate collaborated for Joint Budget Hearings. Today marked the last of twelve. Capitol Correspondent Jordan Sartor-Francis at the capitol today speaking with lawmakers and experts as the budget due date comes within a month.

item.title: Utica man arrested for allegedly starving, beating children
item.description: Utica Police have announced the arrest of a man during an investigation into child abuse at a Lansing Street residence on Thursday.

item.title: Town of Decatur supervisor arrested
item.description: Otsego County Sheriffs arrested the town of Decatur Supervisor on Friday for official misconduct.

item.title: Oneida County, Sheriff's Office agree on new CBA
item.description: Oneida County Executive Anthony Picente announced on Friday that the county and the Oneida County Sheriff's Office have reached a new collective bargaining agreement.

item.title: Police issue 50,000+ tickets over Super Bowl week in New York
item.description: New York State law enforcement officers issued 50,621 tickets to drivers during the 2026 Super Bowl weekend, including 1,235 for impaired driving, in an effort to deter dangerous driving.

item.title: Federal judge blocks USDA from withholding SNAP over missing New York data
item.description: A federal judge has ordered the USDA to stop withholding food assistance funds from New York and other states that have not shared personal data about SNAP recipients, while a related lawsuit proceeds through the courts.

item.title: Increasing clouds Saturday before a light snow chance Saturday night!
item.description: Tonight, temperatures drop back into the 20s and 30s as a weak front moves in. Most of the moisture with it will have a tough time overcoming dry air, but a little rain or a rain–snow mix is possible late tonight into early Saturday, mainly across north-central New York and up toward the Tug Hill.
